audience: farm managers and agronomists who track fields with satellite, weather and soil data

useCases.title: List fields and their size in hectares
useCases.text: List your fields as polygons, with the area of each in hectares. Open one to see its geometry and centre.

useCases.title: Track crop health with satellite images and NDVI
useCases.text: Search the satellite images of a field for a time range. Read the NDVI history of the same field to see the trend.

useCases.title: Check the weather at a farm location
useCases.text: Read the current weather at a latitude and longitude. Read the 5-day forecast for the same location, in 3-hour steps.

useCases.title: Read soil and UV data for a field
useCases.text: Read the current soil temperature and moisture of a field. Read the current UV index for the same field.

useCases.title: Add a new field from its boundary
useCases.text: Create a polygon from a GeoJSON boundary in longitude and latitude order. Rename it if the name needs a change.
